labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Must have pathologically documented, locally advanced or metastatic RAS-mutated NSCLC (Subprotocol B)

labels.note: Patient has resected stage IIB disease on adjuvant pembrolizumab; no advanced disease; RAS untested.

evidence.quote: Participants must have received platinum-based chemotherapy and experienced disease progression
Participants must have measurable or non-measurable disease documented by CT or MRI.
Metastatic disease (stage IV) detected on imaging
Participants must have received at least one line of systemic treatment for Stage IV or recurrent NSCLC
Participants must have documentation of NSCLC with MET amplification
Stage IV mNSCLC (metastatic non-small cell lung cancer)
Any prior treatment with an anti-PD-1 (programmed cell death protein 1) or anti-PD-L1 (anti-programmed death-ligand 1) agent.
pathologically documented, KRAS G12C-mutated, advanced or metastatic solid tumors not amendable to curative therapy
Have historically or pathologically confirmed diagnosis of metastatic Stage IV NSCLC
Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC, not amenable to curative surgery or radiotherapy.
Histologically or cytologically confirmed NSCLC with Stage IIIB-IIIC or Stage IV disease
Have predominantly squamous cell histology for NSCLC
Have systemic treatment naive, histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of Stage IIIB or IIIC
Previous chemotherapy (platinum-based) or PD(L)-1 for treating NSCLC in either neoadjuvant/adjuvant or locally advanced/metastatic setting.
Patients must have pathologically confirmed Extensive Stage Small Cell Lung Cancer (ES-SCLC).
Have cytologically or histologically and radiologically confirmed recurrent or metastatic disease
